name: knead_wan
default_prompt: the cat kneads with its front paw, body still

1-4.prompt: the cat shifts on the spot from sitting facing the viewer to sitting turned three-quarters to its left side, keeping its face toward the viewer, eyes open

4-3.prompt: the cat lifts one front paw off the ground and curls it, eyes open, body still

3-2.prompt: the cat stretches the lifted front paw forward and presses it down with claws out, kneading, eyes open
